primary.diagnosis: FLIP45 harm reduced by two thirds against the v1 learner (paired, significant) but its 95% upper bound (+0.000655) exceeds tau_safe (+0.0005). The Occam rule selected on point estimates; the DEV round-1 upper bound (+0.00060) had already exceeded the tolerance (disclosed in SELECTION_V2.json). Mechanism: with four duplicate pairs a near-noise channel (q=0.45) leaves weight on the q=0.2 hypothesis whenever chance produces few disagreements, and that hypothesis over-adapts.
